2760-4279-7452.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-7452.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-7452.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

7084-7893-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

240-4885-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

1453-2981-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-2981-4694-7306.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1168-1479-2841-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1168-1479-2841-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2185-6972-8095.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1379-3967-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-3967-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Yahenni.

719-2438-3413.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6996-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6996-7818.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-3259-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
955-3259-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

2263-5708-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
2263-5708-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Mindcrusher.
Geralf's Mindcrusher dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Vein Ripper
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Mindcrusher, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5256-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5256-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

457-1792-4404-6709.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
457-1792-4404-6709.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2577-7390.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1765-6798-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3594-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6289-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6289-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

813-957-3306.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
813-957-3306.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

5147-5394-6291.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-5931.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You control an additional creature.
2034-3097-3490-5931.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room // Awakening Hall triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

3705-4833-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

997-2178-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
997-2178-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Eldrazi token.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1511-1636-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vitaspore Thallid has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1511-1636-4312.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Vitaspore Thallid.
Activate Vitaspore Thallid by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Vitaspore Thallid if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo.

152-1379-2441.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Rasputin Dreamweaver with haste.
Put the oldest Rasputin Dreamweaver into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Rasputin Dreamweaver's first ability seven times by removing seven dream counters from it, adding seven {C}.
Repeat.

2757-2850-5189.notablePrerequisites:
There is a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
You control a basic land.
2757-2850-5189.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling token, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

1331-4772-4979-5157.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Gilded Goose.
You control at least two Foods.
1331-4772-4979-5157.description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Gilded Goose to deal six damage to itself.
Gilded Goose dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Gilded Goose from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Repeat.

77-2559-4030-4399.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Brilliant Halo.
Brilliant Halo triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Brilliant Halo by paying two life, targeting any creature.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2305-3604-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Frodo.
Frodo does not have summoning sickness.
You have been tempted by the Ring at least four times this game.
Opponents are unable to block creatures you control.
2305-3604-3851.description:
Activate Frodo's first ability by paying {W/B}{W/B}, causing it to become a 2/3 Halfling Scout.
Activate Frodo's second ability by paying {B}{B}{B}, causing it to become a 2/3 Halfling Rogue.
Declare Frodo as an attacker.
Frodo's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of Frodo attacking each other opponent.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 for each Frodo token.
Deal combat damage using the Frodos.
The Frodos trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

632-1636-4497.notablePrerequisites:
You control an artifact creature with mana value at least five.
Slobad and Scarecrone do not have summoning sickness.
632-1636-4497.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature with mana value five or greater, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate artifact abilities.
Activate Scarecrone's last ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1293-2232-2757-3474.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Forest and a basic Plains.
1293-2232-2757-3474.description:
Activate a basic Plains and a basic Forest you control by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Cast Isamaru by paying {W}.
Isamaru enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft twice by tapping the Cat Warrior token and Isamaru, untapping a basic Forest and a basic Plains.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Isamaru from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-2793-2829-5089.notablePrerequisites: Karn has at least three loyalty counters.
1170-2793-2829-5089.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Karn's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Karn.
Repeat.

190-1321-2389.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Immortal Coil and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Cast Kaya's Guile by paying {1}{W}{B}, exiling all cards from all graveyards and choosing any other mode.
Each opponent's Immortal Coil triggers, causing them to lose the game.

803-1486-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
803-1486-4644.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

3284-3809-4124.description:
Cast Whip Silk for {G}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Goldspan Dragon triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}.
Korvold triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and drawing a card.
Activate Whip Silk for {G}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

776-1329-1834-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-1834-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Briber's Purse to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Briber's Purse.
Cast Briber's Purse.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
